statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to neurological and vestibular symptoms
The associated diagnosis codes are G45.9 and R42
The denial reason is CO-197, indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
